title: Keep selected invoice stdout bytes consistent with its receipt
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

On Windows, `export_selected_invoice.py` hashes LF-terminated JSON for `invoice_sha256`, then `print()` emits CRLF. Its successful export therefore produces bytes that do not match the receipt. The old integration test used `text=True`, which normalized the difference away.

Use one UTF-8/LF serialization for hashing and binary stdout. The integration test now hashes the actual subprocess bytes and feeds those same bytes to the comparator. A portable regression covers LF, CRLF and UTF-16 text wrappers; the latter two fail against the original implementation. This repairs output binding, with no new mathematical or kappa claim and no changes to selected or frozen scientific inputs.

## Task and overlap

Started from and refreshed canonical main `de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a`, priority revision 8. Task `portable-replay`, scope key `91a9a2afec282c926282`; changed from the suggested gzip audit to this demonstrated current-exporter failure. The [review note](https://github.com/josecarlosgonzalezroque-design/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e0926d31a4947c98352571c6d76dec244eeaa776/docs/research/selected-invoice-output-bytes.md) records exact hashes, source heads, bounded overlap coverage and the reason for the change. Before submission on 2026-10-27, refreshed canonical main to `19fdb086ea96af9a9f87936a2b888e10af4ed810`: the exporter, its tests, the selected baseline and comparator are unchanged from the tested base. A targeted PR search for `export_selected_invoice` updated since 2026-10-26 returned no matches. PR #5735 supplies the exporter; #5733 already uses binary stdout in a different invoice-composition command.

## Validation

Windows 11 build 26300 / CPython 3.12.10:

```sh
python -B scripts/research_selected_baseline.py
python -B tests/test_research_selected_invoice.py -v
python -I -O -B tests/test_research_selected_invoice.py -v
python -B tests/test_compare_recursive_invoices.py -v
git diff --check
```

All 8 exporter tests pass in both modes, retaining accounting and source-corruption controls. All 10 comparator tests, the selected binding-only baseline and diff check pass. The published tree `f0c2e1f1b9f43339d6e76bd56f6412644c062b40` matches the tested local tree. POSIX execution, cold scientific replay and hosted-CI success are not claimed. The initial sandbox TEMP permission failure and workspace-local remedy are documented.

## Credit

Credit Ali Romman's exporter in #5735 and the retained P104/controller/invoice contributors. Prepared for josecarlosgonzalezroque-design with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, one agent. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

Run the raw-byte CLI regression on POSIX or another Windows Python version. The review note gives the scope and first step; no construction or frontier change follows from this repair.
